our-tampines-hub.text: Attention Tampines residents and hub visitors! No exercise sessions at OTH Gate 1 on 8 November 2026 due to Public Holiday. Wishing all happy holidays.

🏑 Ready to hit the court? The OTH Floorball Fiesta 2026 is here! Gather your squad and get ready for an action-packed day of fast-paced floorball. Whether you're competing in the Under 19 or Open category, it's time to showcase your skills! Date: 13 December 2026 Time: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Venue: Level 3 Community Auditorium, Our Tampines Hub 💰 FREE Registration! Format: 3v3 Team Size: Min. 3 to max. 6 players per team Don't miss out on the excitement—secure your spot today! 🔗 Sign up here: Https://www.pathway-expert.com/PEOS/index.php?t=OTHFLB2026 Organised by Our Tampines Hub and Tampines West CSN in partnership with Singapore Floorball Association.
